title: Major muscles of the body, anterior and posterior views
source: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology / Wikimedia Commons
notes: This replaces the previous 587x612 image with a high-resolution anatomical asset.
Existing ionm-coords.json coordinates were created on the previous image and must be clinically re-curated against this exact asset before production training use.
Until every point is clinically re-curated, legacy ionm-coords.json points are normalized at runtime from legacy anterior/posterior bounds into the current body.jpg asset bounds.
The image includes printed labels and leader lines; future final asset may use a clean unlabeled anatomical plate if a licensed source is selected.
